description: This Java source file defines the LogFragment class, a Fragment subclass that manages a LogView UI component within an Android application. It creates a ScrollView containing a LogView, sets up layout parameters, styling, and a text watcher to automatically scroll when new log data is added. The class provides access to the LogView instance for other components to write logs.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that displays log messages within a scrollable, styled TextView (LogView), with automatic scrolling behavior on new log entries.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures a ScrollView containing a LogView, sets layout parameters, padding, typeface, and gravity, and returns the constructed view hierarchy.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Called to create the Fragment's view hierarchy; it inflates the view, sets up a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on text change, and returns the view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Provides external access to the LogView component for logging output.
